title: Different needs give openness support
meaning: Open shared action to combine different needs is emotionally answered by clear support and understandable boundaries.
text: The Star in the physical position of this Energy Field describes open shared actions: you may share attention, show something important without demanding return and leave room for possibility. Temperance in energy gives a motive to combine different needs. The Emperor in emotions adds support from defined boundaries and an understandable arrangement. Open practice can recognise different capacities without requiring one form of participation. Emotional clarity guarantees no boundaries suitable for both people forever and does not turn one person’s need for definition into authority over the other.

For example, you offer friends a small open viewing. One person wants to avoid becoming tired from lengthy conversation, while the other values time for questions. Wanting room for both requests helps define a short showing followed by an optional discussion. **Our openness has clear boundaries with room for different needs.** Calm concerns a particular arrangement; it does not prove equal desire for another gathering or readiness to expand its scale. An organised offer can remain limited to the present occasion.

Boundaries become rigid if the feeling of support prohibits changing the proportion. One person now assesses the burden differently while the other considers earlier calm proof of a successful scheme. The Emperor makes no order final, and Temperance requires no permanent compromise. The Star in action permits possibility without guaranteed return, preserving room to reduce involvement. Open attention can remain real while both people clarify different limitations and readiness to continue. Clarity can support reconsideration rather than prevent it.
